description: This PHP class 'WorkShiftDecorator' is part of the OrangeHRM system, providing a decorator for the 'WorkShift' entity to format start and end times using helper traits.

classes.name: WorkShiftDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps a WorkShift entity to provide formatted start and end time strings using helper traits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a WorkShift entity.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted start time as a string, or null if unavailable.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted end time as a string, or null if unavailable.
